headline: ERS opens online registration for European Parliament respiratory health policy discussion
dek: The European Respiratory Society said online registration is available for a high-level policy discussion in Brussels on 11 November.
body:
The European Respiratory Society (ERS) said online registration is open for a high-level policy discussion titled "From JARED to sustained European action on respiratory health". The society announced this in a post on X on 10 November.

According to the post, the discussion is being held on 11 November at the European Parliament in Brussels, Belgium. The post described the event as a "high-level policy discussion" and said online registration is available.

The post directed readers to a link for further information and registration, and tagged the @EuropeanLung account. It did not give a programme, a list of speakers or further details of what the discussion will cover.
key_quote: From JARED to sustained European action on respiratory health
